# Generated Vietnamese engine integration

`iztro-vietnam.cjs` is generated from pinned `iztro@2.6.2`, the project's calendar
bridge and `@dqcai/vn-lunar@1.0.1` ESM entry. No installed package is patched.
Run `npm run engine:build` to regenerate and `npm run engine:check` to detect stale
artifacts. The application build includes this check. Do not edit generated output.

The iztro MIT license is preserved in the generated header:
Copyright (c) 2023 All Contributors.

The published Vietnamese calendar package declares MIT in its package metadata,
with author Đoàn Quốc Cường. Its original module retains the notice
“© 2025 Refactored for TypeScript”. No separate LICENSE file ships in the package.
